Vampire.About: A vampire stalking the streets of Blightmeer.
Event: Spawn in contact with the nearest terrain piece that blocks Line-of-Sight to the Event chest.
Logic: He Targets the nearest unit that is not Undead and performs Normal Actions.
If a Target is within Engage distance he will always Engage rather than Move.
Once Hunger reaches 2, he disappears from the board at the end of his turn.
Patronage: Ensure the Vampire Incapacitates two units in a single battle.

Event: Spawn on the board edge closest to the Event chest.
Logic: He Targets the nearest Undead or Blighted unit, otherwise the Triggering Unit.
While he has Line-of-Sight to his Target he holds position and makes Ranged Attacks, only Moving to regain it.
Patronage: Ensure the Hunter Incapacitates an Undead or Blighted unit.

Blight Prophet.About: A herald of the Blight, spreading its gift to all who draw near.
Event: Spawn within 3" of the Event chest.
Logic: He casts Gift of Blight every turn, even if it would only catch allies.
Each turn he Moves towards the largest group of units within 12".
If he is Incapacitated he automatically casts Gift of Blight.
Patronage: Ensure three units contract the Blight from the Blight Prophet.

Inquisitor.About: A holy warrior of the church, wielding divine power to heal allies and purge the Blight.
Event: Spawn on a random edge of the nearest building to the Event chest.
Logic: If he starts his turn next to a unit with the Blight, he will cast Cure Blight.
Each turn he will move towards the nearest building and light it on fire.
Patronage: Ensure the Inquisitor heals the Blight off one unit.

Shady Merchant.About: A merchant of questionable morals who always seems to have exactly what you need... for a price.
Event: Spawn on the board edge nearest the Treasure token furthest from the Event chest.
Logic: Each turn he Moves towards the nearest unit carrying Treasure and attempts to Steal it.
If he is carrying Treasure he instead Retreats, leaving the game once he reaches a board edge.
Patronage: Ensure the Shady Merchant leaves the board carrying a Treasure.

Pit Fighter.About: A veteran of the pits, hardened by countless brutal fights.
Event: Spawn within 3" of the nearest pair of Engaged units, or the Event chest if none are Engaged.
Logic: Each turn he Engages the nearest unit, preferring one that is already Engaged.
He will never pick up Treasure.
Patronage: Ensure the Pit Fighter wins three rounds of Melee combat.
